scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run build -w @peoplepay360/shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @peoplepay360/api" "npm run dev -w @peoplepay360/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @peoplepay360/shared && npm run build -w @peoplepay360/api && npm run build -w @peoplepay360/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @peoplepay360/shared && npm run typecheck -w @peoplepay360/api && npm run typecheck -w @peoplepay360/web
